select TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_TYPE feeType, TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_AMT feeAmt from TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID feeId, FIN_PRODUCT.p_Finprod_Id finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID sfinprodId, to_char(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH) branch, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE calcStartDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE calcEndDate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE payDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CLEAN isClean, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT actPayAmt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_AMT payAmt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT adjustAmt from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL, FIN_PRODUCT, TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL, MST_FEEINFO, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID=PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
SELECT PAY_CYCLE FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE WHERE CASH_ID = #{cashId} and eff_date <= to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and ROWNUM <= 1

select dat.resiPrincipal from ( select psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_CASH_POSITION psp
where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and psp.CDATE <= to_date(#{payDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_CASH_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID
and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= to_date(#{payDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) order by psp.CDATE desc )dat where rownum = 1

SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN inner JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE = #{chargeType_01} and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and decode(MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE, #{feeType_03, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, 0, #{feeType_04, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, 0, #{feeType_12, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, 0, 1) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.Mdate = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C11} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId})

select nvl(sum(nvl(fee_amt, 0)), 0) from trd_trade_fee_detail where fee_type = #{feeType1} and trade_id in (select deal.trade_id from trd_product_deal deal, trd_product_deal_add add1, fin_product prod, fin_deal_pledge ple where prod.finprod_type2 in ('F01', 'F02', 'F03', 'F04', 'F05') and is_cancel = 'N' and add1.trade_id = deal.trade_id and add1.portfolio_id = #{ptlId} and deal.trade_date <= to_date(#{cdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and prod.finprod_id = ple.pledge_finprod_id and ple.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id and prod.REGIST_ORG = #{org})

LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO MST_FEEINFO1 ON TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_ID where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select FINPROD_ID finprodId from PRD_LAYER_PARAM where P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

select MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASIS basis, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType from FIN_CASH_INFO,MST_FEEINFO,FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = #{feeId} and FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = (select max(ccr.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE ccr where ccr.cash_id = FIN_CASH_INFO.cash_id and ccr.eff_date <= to_date(#{enddate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = '03' LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO MST_FEEINFO1 ON TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_ID WHERE TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.BUSI_TYPE = 'FINPROD19' AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND (MST_FEEINFO.Fee_Id = #{feeId} OR MST_FEEINFO1.Fee_Id = #{feeId} ) AND (TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE > to_date(#{payDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') or ( TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE = to_date(#{payDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.Mdate > to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) ) AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID != #{tradeId}
